svg.aria-label: Vision. An evidence-first workbench for Ethereum: search an address or transaction, inspect the transfers behind a label, and export exactly what the local index saw. A replay comparison checks an importer against archived receipts block by block. Shown as two rows of three blocks under a scanning frame; two pairs match in green and one differs in amber.
